# The AI Capital Drain

Report 192 | Published 2026-07-05 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2026-7-5/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/192.json)

AI capital spending, sector rotation and treasury resilience.

The chip-to-software rotation is supported by subsequent prices, and the IREN put’s expiration condition succeeded despite later stock weakness. The report correctly highlights capex pressure but overgeneralizes negative free cash flow. Its flow narrative and private AI experiment require more evidence.

**Coverage:** Full numbered text and image inventory read. All material theses across macro, digital assets, investment analysis and concluding sections considered. Position listings and incidental descriptive statistics are excluded unless they support a thesis.

### 192-C03

**Dollar strength restrains global liquidity.**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Mixed |
| Type | explanation |
| Horizon | Not specified |
| Conditions | Not specified |
| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | global-dollar-liquidity |
| Source blocks | 16, 17 |
| Thesis family | global-dollar-liquidity |

Dollar conversion mechanically lowers the dollar value of unchanged foreign-currency money stocks when the dollar rises. Dollar borrowers may also face tighter debt service. That does not make translated global M2 a direct measure of investable capital or identify Warsh remarks as the cause.

**Direction:** See assessment; evidence is limited to the stated proposition.

**Timing:** No fixed deadline stated.

**Mechanism:** Price direction alone does not identify causation.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Deductive assessment:**

- Foreign-currency money quantities unchanged
- Exchange rate expressed as dollars per foreign unit falls

Dollar-translated stock equals local money stock multiplied by the conversion rate; translation alone reduces the measured dollar stock.

**Outcome evidence:**

No independent outcome source is recorded. Any deductive assessment is identified separately.

### 192-C19

**Strategy’s revised policy addresses liquidity fragility.**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Mixed |
| Type | explanation |

| Conditions | Not specified |

The June 29 announcement verifies the board policy, reserve replenishment and repurchase authorizations. STRC’s later recovery is favorable without proving the policy alone caused it.

**Direction:** See assessment; evidence is limited to the stated proposition.

**Timing:** No fixed deadline stated.

**Mechanism:** Price direction alone does not identify causation.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Outcome evidence:**

- [Digital Credit Capital Framework](https://www.strategy.com/press/strategy-announces-digital-credit-capital-framework_06-29-2026) | Strategy | 2026-06-29 | Verified in the audit

USD reserve $2.55bn, 17.4 months of $1.76bn annual preferred dividends and interest. Board adopted a 12-month minimum unless expressly waived, buyback authorizations, and BTC monetization capacity.

- [STRC market history](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/STRC/history/) | Yahoo Finance | Verified in the audit

June 22-November 6 adjusted return +17.56%; not a causal estimate of the June 29 policy.

## Analytical tools and charts

- **Global M2 in dollars:** Currency-adjusted liquidity proxy Visual inspection: yes.
- **GDPNow:** Nowcast revisions Visual inspection: not performed.
- **Hyperscaler FCF:** Capex funding Visual inspection: not performed.
- **FAST Graphs:** Valuation and earnings Visual inspection: not performed.
- **Market-cap share:** Scale comparison Visual inspection: not performed.

## Framework lessons

- Match the outcome window to the instrument’s actual maturity.
- A market-cap change is not a dollar-for-dollar capital flow.

## Verification limitations

- Current page snapshot is not an authenticated publication-date version.
- A missing horizon is not replaced with an invented author deadline.
- Market sensitivities use vendor adjusted closes and do not reconstruct portfolio execution.
